About Me

I'm a Site Reliability & DevOps Engineer with 7+ years keeping production systems healthy across AWS, Azure, GCP, and on-premise Linux and Windows servers.

My strongest work happens in the middle of an incident. During a live bot attack I traced the real impact past the bots to a caching misconfiguration and slow Kubernetes autoscaling, and gave the client a clear fix. Today I'm a Senior Cloud Solutions Engineer at Sitecore, where I support a multi-region Azure setup with cross-region database replication.

I build the monitoring that catches problems early (Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Datadog, Azure Monitor) and automate repetitive operations with Bash, Python, and PowerShell. Production changes I lead go out from runbooks proven in test, with clear rollback points. I also write about DevOps and cloud on Medium.

Experience

Senior Cloud Solutions Engineer

Sitecore

Aug 2025 - PresentSri Lanka
  • Led the incident investigation of a live bot attack against an Azure Front Door-fronted application using KQL and Log Analytics. Traced the impact to rotating-IP traffic, a caching misconfiguration that sent every request to the origin, and HPA scaling lag, then delivered findings and mitigation steps to the client.
  • Support a multi-region Azure setup for high availability and disaster recovery: application traffic load-balanced across two regions by Cloudflare, with critical databases replicated between regions.
  • Led a Sitecore 10.3.1 to 10.4.1 platform upgrade across test and production on AKS and Azure SQL, including a SolrCloud migration from 8.11.2 to 9.8.1. Wrote and ran a 21-step runbook with rollback points and content-freeze windows, coordinated across infrastructure and client teams.
  • Retired a legacy ELK logging stack (Elastic Cloud, Filebeat, Logstash) after mapping its dependencies, consolidating monitoring on Azure Monitor and Datadog and cutting logging costs without losing visibility.
  • Automated SolrCloud and ZooKeeper operations with PowerShell, including alias-based zero-downtime reindexing, and hardened the clusters with SSL/HTTPS.
  • Automated after-hours shutdown of non-production AKS clusters and VMs with custom scripts run from scheduled Azure DevOps pipelines under a service principal. Environments stop outside working hours and start again before the workday, cutting idle compute spend.
